title: Hata maveterani hufanya kazi na mwongozo wazi

text.Even the veterans work with the manual o: Hata maveterani hufanya kazi na mwongozo wazi
text.Honestly, at first I thought it might be: Kwa uaminifu, mwanzoni nilidhani inaweza kuwa rahisi, kwa sababu ni kazi ya muda.
text.But I was very wrong. There is a monstro: Lakini nilikosea sana. Kuna kiasi cha kutisha cha kukumbuka.
text.Equipment model numbers, types of servic: Nambari za mfano wa vifaa, aina za huduma na mtandao, kuwaambia kengele, kutenganisha makosa, kupanga wahandisi wa shamba, kufanya kazi na idara zingine, kuangalia na waendeshaji wengine, kuripoti baada ya kupona.
text.If you tried to manage all of that with: Ukijaribu kudhibiti yote hayo kwa daftari la karatasi, bila shaka ungevunja.
text.Actually, even the senior people who hav: Kwa kweli, hata watu wakuu ambao wamefanya hivi kwa miaka mingi kimsingi hufanya kazi huku wakiangalia mwongozo.
text.It is not an amount you can memorise one: Sio kiasi ambacho unaweza kukariri moja baada ya nyingine.
text.So the more veteran someone is, the more: Kwa hivyo kadiri mtu anavyokuwa mkongwe zaidi, ndivyo anavyoweka kwa uzuri orodha ya njia za mkato zinazowafikisha kwenye mwongozo katika hatua chache zaidi.
text.Rather than remembering everything, keep: Badala ya kukumbuka kila kitu, kuweka maelezo unayohitaji karibu nayo. Nadhani huo ndio ustadi muhimu zaidi kwenye sakafu hii.
text.There are 3 kinds of people I deal with: Kuna 3 aina ya watu ninaoshughulika nao
text.The night is quiet until an alarm goes o: Usiku ni tulivu hadi kengele inalia
